name: NIH RePORTER
summary: NIH RePORTER's API over federally funded research awards (NIH and other agencies): search projects by investigator, organization, fiscal year, text, funding and dates, and find the publications linked to them.
notes: Free and keyless. NIH asks for no more than one request per second, and large jobs on weekends or weekdays 9 PM-5 AM Eastern; abusive IPs get blocked.
Both calls are reads over POST with a JSON body.
No fuzzy, proximity or range searches except where a criterion says so (name and org fields are wildcard-matched).
Paging: limit (default 50, max 500) and offset (max 14,999); larger result sets must be split with narrower criteria.

endpoints.name: Search funded projects
endpoints.summary: Research projects matching criteria, with award amounts, investigators, organization, dates, abstract and terms.

criteria.description: Search criteria, e.g. fiscal_years [2023], pi_names [{any_name}], org_names, org_states, project_nums, agencies, activity_codes, award_amount_range {min_amount,max_amount}, project_start_date {from_date,to_date}, advanced_text_search {operator, search_field, search_text}, use_relevance.

include_fields.description: Only these result fields (PascalCase names, e.g. ApplId, ProjectNum, OrgName, AwardAmount).

notes: The response meta carries a search_id and a RePORTER web URL for the same result set; a later request can pass only search_id to page the same search.

endpoints.name: Find publications of projects
endpoints.summary: Links between projects and PubMed publications: PMID, core project number and application id.

criteria.description: One or more of pmids, appl_ids, core_project_nums (lists).

notes: A read over POST. Returns ids only; fetch the articles themselves from PubMed by PMID.
